placements.why: Both expressions describe a ratified, load-bearing technical contract (dispatch, receipt, polling, no-blocking, no-lost-work) governing how the remember pipeline behaves — an organizational-strategy category (system architecture/contracts) that nothing in the empty strata list yet covers, and future envelopes will keep filing architectural contracts of this kind under it.
placements.title: System behavior is governed by ratified technical contracts
placements.frame: What architectural guarantee or contract governs how this system component behaves?

placements.title: Remember's result is decoupled from its dispatch
placements.frame: What guarantee does the ratified async contract make about how a dispatched job's receipt, progress, and eventual result reach the caller without a blocking call or lost work?
placements.why: src-1 states the ratified top-line guarantees of the async job contract (receipt in seconds, cursor-polled extraction, no blocking call, no lost work) and src-2 restates the underlying dispatch mechanism (dispatch, then poll-or-piggyback) as the key decision producing those guarantees — both are the same directional theme of decoupled dispatch/result-delivery design that future envelopes discussing this contract's mechanics will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
